key_concepts: An electromagnet is a temporary magnet
An electromagnet uses an iron core
A battery or dry cell provides electricity to an electromagnet
Electric current flows through a coil of wire around an iron core
Increasing the number of wire coils strengthens an electromagnet
Increasing the number of batteries or dry cells strengthens an electromagnet
A larger iron core makes an electromagnet stronger
An electromagnet can be turned on and off
If electricity stops flowing, the nail stops attracting magnetic materials
Number of coils, number of batteries, and core properties affect electromagnet strength
